name: Supercar Track
author: idv7lol contributors
description: A track cluster in the style of Italian supercars: a thick segmented rev band counting to 10 under a yellow rim, red from 7, a huge red gear in the middle with the drive mode beside it, the odometer and range to its right, speed bottom right, a hexagon floor with a lane in perspective, and leaning bars for oil, water, fuel and gearbox oil in the side panels.
